plugins.name: pomo
plugins.description: A focus dashboard beside the chat with a live pomodoro countdown, buttons, daily progress, the week at a glance, soft chimes and optional logging to your Obsidian daily note.

plugins.name: ember-theme
plugins.description: A warm, dark-only theme for long sessions. Charcoal, ember orange and cream text, with no blue anywhere.
